verdict.rationale: Resend's pricing page states dedicated IPs are automatically warmed up, monitored, and autoscaled based on utilization, indicating an automated warmup ramp exists for dedicated IPs on higher plans. However, there is no dedicated documentation page detailing the warmup schedule, timeline, or configuration options, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of how this warmup process performs in practice. Missing for 10: detailed published warmup schedule/documentation, independent verification of warmup effectiveness, and any support for custom warmup pacing.
